name: CPI FIM SA
summary: CPI FIM SA is the real estate investment arm of CPI Property Group specializing in Real Estate. Formerly known as Orco Property Group, the firm operates as an investor, developer, and asset manager. It focuses on income-generating real estate assets. The firm invests across the Central European market, Czechia, Berlin, and the Central and Eastern Europe region. CPI FIM SA was founded in 1991 and is based in Luxembourg, Luxembourg.
